description: One API operation candidate or change requested by the architect lane.

fields.name: intent
fields.description: Business intent of this operation or contract change.

fields.name: method
fields.description: HTTP method when the architect can already define it, for example GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE.

fields.name: path
fields.description: HTTP path when the architect can already define the service API contract location.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: Path, query, header, or other operation parameters when already known.

fields.name: request
fields.description: Expected request body shape when already known. Use an empty fields array when there is no request body.

fields.name: response
fields.description: Expected response body shape when already known. Use an empty fields array when no response body is relevant.
